falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes at a new 63-day high and finishes the 14-day window at least 3.0% above today's close, while the percentage of S&P 500 members above their 50-day moving average rises by at least 8 percentage points.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A breadth-confirmed breakout invalidates the mini_top_2019_jun analog and shows HOLD was the wrong call; the tape resolved risk-on, not as an unresolved top.

falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes at least 6.0% below today's close within 14 days, with VIX closing above 25 on at least three sessions in that window.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A volatility-confirmed drawdown larger than a June-2019-style pause proves UNKNOWN/HOLD wrong; the setup was an actionable risk-off top, not an unresolvable mini-top.

falsification_conditions.condition: US high-yield option-adjusted spread widens by 75 basis points or more versus today's level at any close in the next 14 days, or the blowoff score prints at or above 80.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A credit-stress or true blowoff print falsifies both the moderate blowoff reading (56) and the HOLD; the regime is no longer unknown and the mini-top template does not fit.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
